raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivers amount strings with a '$' prefix, e.g. '$14.09', and the DECIMAL cast fails on them. Earlier batches have plain numerics. The currency is always USD, so stripping the symbol is unambiguous, and the string min/max show no thousands separators or negatives.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
